entities.summary: Soviet occupation (June 1940), the staged elections and annexation, the 'Year of Terror' — nationalisation, NKVD arrests, and the devastating deportation of 14 June 1941 sending over 15,000 Latvians to Siberia, including the Ulmanis government.
